repository.name: @webex/storage-adapter-spec
repository.purpose: Defines the behavioral contract every Webex storage adapter must satisfy, as an executable conformance suite that consumer packages run against their own adapter.

commands.compile: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- no standalone compile step exists; transpilation happens inside the build:src command, which also emits the distributable output rather than compiling sources on their own.
commands.unit-test: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- this package defines no test:unit script and owns no test file; it ships the shared conformance suite that sibling workspace packages execute. The command that actually runs the suite is contract-verify below. Confirmed intentional by the package owner during bootstrap onboarding.

qa.location: Sibling workspace packages in the same repository: @webex/webex-core executes the suite under Node against MemoryStoreAdapter, while @webex/storage-adapter-local-storage, @webex/storage-adapter-local-forage, and @webex/storage-adapter-session-storage wrap their call in skipInNode and therefore only exercise it in a browser runner.
qa.notes: This package owns no test file, so its unit tier is satisfied entirely by a sibling package. Verified 2026-09-23: contract-verify executed 21 of 21 cases and passed, while yarn workspace @webex/storage-adapter-local-storage test:unit exited zero with all 21 cases skipped. The package-level test script is stale: it invokes test:unit and test:integration, neither of which this package.json defines.

spec_source_policy.decision_record: No prior intent or design spec existed in this package. README.md is a repository-owned governance/usage document, preserved untouched and used only as corroborating evidence; it is not routed as spec source material.

modules.coverage_evidence: Field measurement complete 2026-09-23, revised after independent validation: 95%, 21 of 22 mandatory spec fields PRESENT, test strategy WEAK. The canonical spec at src/docs/README.md records 14 requirements and 5 invariants, three of which carry Weak confidence: MOD-010 and MOD-013 have no case that observes them at all, and MOD-014 is partially verified - a case proves the single-key result while namespace-wide scope and the clear argument contract remain unresolved. INV-005 carries the same gap as MOD-010. The suite's declared cases are executed in this repository by the sibling package @webex/webex-core (21 of 21 passing, verified 2026-09-23); the remaining gap is that nothing pins the number or shape of the declarations, so deleting a case would reduce the contract without failing any run. Status is held at Untracked pending the human promotion decision recorded in the first coverage review, not because coverage is unmeasured.

storage-adapter-spec-suite.summary: The package's single published surface: the default export runAbstractStorageAdapterSpec, invoked by consumer packages inside their own test declarations, together with the storage adapter interface it requires of its argument - bind(namespace, options) resolving to a handle owning put, get, del, and clear. package.json is the ecosystem-native manifest declaring the published entry points. The interface half has no machine-readable artifact of its own, so src/index.js remains its authoritative definition and the owning module spec specifies it in full.

module_docs_decision.reason: The default source-local route was confirmed with the owner because src/ is the transpile input for the published output and the lint command globs all of src/. Both were checked: the build processes only js/ts sources, and the resolved eslint configuration ignores markdown, so the default route is safe and was kept.

repo_context_decision.reason: Neither the repository operational-context manifest nor its schema existed at its fixed path in this package; both were created from verified repository evidence.

artifact_decisions.reason: This package is a library published to npm, not a deployable service. package.json declares no container, deployment manifest, or start command.
No docs-site publishing workflow exists in this package, and the owner chose to leave documentation-site ownership at the monorepo root.
The package exposes no HTTP surface. Its published contract is an npm/SDK surface whose ecosystem-native authoritative source is src/index.js.
Security policy is owned at the monorepo root; a package-local copy would duplicate or contradict it.
Contribution instructions are owned at the monorepo root; a package-local copy would duplicate or contradict them.
The workspace generates its changelog through its release tooling at the monorepo root; a package-local changelog would not be maintained by it.
The CTO readiness checklist is selected only for a deployable service; this package is a library.
Omitted together with CTO_CHECKLIST.yml, which the contract requires to be selected as a pair.
